item.title: IEEE Power & Energy Society Announces New Artificial Intelligence for Power Systems Coordinating Committee - IEEE Power & Energy Society
item.description: The IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) announces the formation of the IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) Artificial Intelligence for Power Systems Coordinating Committee (AIPSCC)—a new coordinating committee created to accelerate collaboration, knowledge exchange, and innovation at the intersection of artificial intelligence and the electric power industry.

item.title: IEEE Power & Energy Society and CIGRE Renew Strategic Partnership - IEEE Power & Energy Society
item.description: The IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) and the International Council on Large Electric Systems (CIGRE) have renewed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to continue to strengthen collaboration, enhance knowledge sharing, and amplify their impact on the global power and energy industry.

item.title: The Passing of Mel Olken - IEEE Power & Energy Society
item.description: The IEEE Power & Energy Society is saddened to announce that Mel Olken, the first IEEE PES Executive Director & the first editor-in-chief of the Power & Energy Magazine, passed away on 9 January 2026 in New York, New York.

item.title: IEEE Power & Energy Society and Reactive Technologies Corporate Engagement Partnership - IEEE Power & Energy Society
item.description: IEEE announced the IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) and Reactive Technologies entered a Corporate Engagement Partnership (CEP) Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to facilitate the involvement of Reactive Technologies associates and corporate leaders in the IEEE PES activities to support PES membership and programs.

item.title: IEEE Power & Energy Society and Chinese Society for Electrical Engineering (CSEE) Enter Strategic Partnership - IEEE Power & Energy Society
item.description: The IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) and Chinese Society for Electrical Engineering (CSEE) have entered a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to facilitate the involvement of CSEE associates and leaders in IEEE PES activities to support PES membership and programs.
